info.description: Food, drink, and happy-hour items. Select one or more Locations to control where each item appears.

allergensReviewed.description: Optional internal verification flag. Website filters use the assigned allergens directly.

allergens.description: Select every major allergen confirmed for this item. These selections appear as icons on the website.

restaurantScope.description: Legacy scope used only when Locations is empty. Prefer selecting restaurants in Locations.

locations.description: Select one or more restaurants. Selected restaurants take precedence over the legacy Restaurant scope. Leave empty with scope all to share everywhere.
